,T2.IS_SEC_BOND, T2.IS_AUTO_UPDATE,

T1.IS_FIN_ORG,
T4.CALENDAR_NAME, T5.CUSTOMER_NAME ISSUER_NAME, T6.REP_REGISTORG_COMMENT repRegistorgComment, T.PFLSH pflsh, T.HAP_CREDIT_AMT hapCreditAmt, T.CREDIT_FLAG creditFlag, T9.ACTUAL_CREDIT_PROVID actualCreditProvid, T1.ISSUER issuer,
T1.SPONSOR sponsor,

left join FIN_POST_INVEST_INFO T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID
left join FIN_PRODUCT_CONVERTIBLE T13 ON T13.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT T11 ON T11.FINPROD_ID = T13.CON_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_DEPT T12 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T12.REP_FINPROD_ID
( T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
OR T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId} ) and T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} and rownum = 1

SELECT GRADE_ORG_ID zxGradeOrgId, GRADE_RESULT zxGradeResult, MAX(GRADE_DATE) FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING WHERE O_CODE = #{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND O_TYPE = #{ZXPJ,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY GRADE_ORG_ID,GRADE_RESULT
select count(1) from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd where tpd.ps in ('T03','T39') and tpd.Trade_Status = '01' and tpd.Is_Cancel = 'N' and tpd.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT count(1) FROM FIN_PRODUCT FP INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON FPA.APPEAR_MARKET_ID = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE FP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT fcpr.CASH_ID, fcpr.EFF_DATE,fcpr.PAY_CYCLE_VAL, fcpr.PAY_CYCLE, fcpr.DAY_TYPE, fcpr.DAY_VALUE, fcpr.END_TDAY_RULE, fcpr.PAY_TDAY_RULE, fcpr.CALC_RULE, fcpr.FIRST_PAY_DATE, fcpr.CASH_UNIT_TYPE, fcpr.FINPROD_ID, fcpr.FINPROD_TYPE,fcpr.FINPROD_TYPE2, fcpr.BRANCH, fcpr.PAY_TYPE, fcpr.REMARK,fcpr.CREATE_USER, fcpr.CREATE_DEPT, fcpr.UPDATE_USER,fcpr.PAY_MONTH FROM FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE fcpr WHERE fcpr.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/

SELECT fcp.CASH_ID, fcp.MDATE, fcp.CASH_NUM, fcp.CASH_TYPE, fcp.VDATE_UNADJUST, fcp.MDATE_UNADJUST, fcp.PAY_DATE_UNADJUST, fcp.VDATE,fcp.PAY_DATE, fcp.TERMDAYS, fcp.VDATE_Y, fcp.VDATE_TERM, fcp.MDATE_TERM,fcp.TERMDAYS_TERM, fcp.PRIN_AMT,fcp.INT_PRIN_AMT, fcp.INT_AMT,fcp.IS_PAY_INT, fcp.CASH_AMT, fcp.CASH_BASEAMT, fcp.CASH_UNIT_TYPE, fcp.CALC_FUNCTION, fcp.FREQUENCY, fcp.FINPROD_ID, fcp.FINPROD_TYPE,fcp.FINPROD_TYPE2, fcp.BRANCH, fcp.PAY_TYPE PAY_TYPE, fcp.RANGE_YIELD,fcp.REMARK, fcp.CREATE_USER, fcp.CREATE_DEPT, fcp.UPDATE_USER,fcp.REPAY_WITHOUT_INT FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp WHERE fcp.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/

SELECT fccr.CASH_ID CASH_ID, fccr.EFF_DATE EFF_DATE, fccr.CALC_TYPE CALC_TYPE, fccr.BASE_TYPE BASE_TYPE, fccr.BASE_DATE_TYPE BASE_DATE_TYPE,fccr.BASIS BASIS, fccr.YIELD YIELD, fccr.IS_INITIAL IS_INITIAL, fccr.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, fccr.FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE,fccr.FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, fccr.BRANCH BRANCH, fccr.REMARK REMARK, fccr.CREATE_USER CREATE_USER,fccr.CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, fccr.UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr WHERE fccr.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/

SELECT CASH_ID CASH_ID, CASH_TYPE_1 CASH_TYPE_1, CASH_TYPE_2 CASH_TYPE_2, CCY CCY, FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE, BRANCH BRANCH, FEE_ID FEE_ID, CHL_FINPROD_ID CHL_FINPROD_ID, CHL_LEVEL CHL_LEVEL, IS_CALC IS_CALC, CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER,COLLECT_TYPE COLLECT_TYPE FROM FIN_CASH_INFO WHERE FINPROD_ID =#{finprodId}

SELECT fri.CASH_ID, fri.EFF_DATE, fri.INT_TYPE, fri.BASIS, fri.RESET_TYPE, fri.RESET_FREQ, fri.FIRST_RESET_DATE, fri.RESET_DATE,fri.OBSERVE_BEF_DAY, fri.OBSERVE_BEF_UNIT, fri.RATE, fri.COEFFICIENT,fri.SPREAD_RATE,fri.HIGHEST_RATE, fri.LOWEST_RATE, fri.BENCHMARK_ID,fri.BENCHMARK_TYPE,fri.FINPROD_ID,fri.BRANCH, fri.FINPROD_TYPE,fri.FINPROD_TYPE2, fri.REMARK,fri.CREATE_USER, fri.CREATE_DEPT, fri.UPDATE_USER,fri.FIRST_CONFIRM_DATE FROM FIN_RATE_INFO fri WHERE fri.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/

SELECT CASH_ID CASH_ID, EXERCISE_TYPE EXERCISE_TYPE, EXERCISE_DATE EXERCISE_DATE, VDATE VDATE, MDATE MDATE, EXERCISE_STATUS EXERCISE_STATUS, EXERCISE_PRICE EXERCISE_PRICE, EXERCISE_REMARK EXERCISE_REMARK, FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE, FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, BRANCH BRANCH, CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME, ACT_EXERCISE_DATE ACT_EXERCISE_DATE FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/

SELECT t1.*, ROUND(100 - SUM(NVL(fcp.prin_amt, 0)), 6) intPrinAmt FROM ( SELECT t8.CASH_ID cashId, t8.CASH_TYPE CASH_TYPE, SUM(T8.QTY)*100 qty, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, nvl(SAI.SEC_ACCT_NAME, fp.FINPROD_NAME) secAcctName, FPD.COLLECT_TYPE collectType, CASE WHEN SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END channel, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, TO_CHAR(t8.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate, TO_CHAR(t8.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, T10.FINPROD_ID, T10.CCY, T10.ISSUER issuer, ROUND(t8.INT_AMT, 12) unitIntAmt,/*单位应计利息*/ TO_CHAR(T10.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDateWhole,/*起息日*/ TO_CHAR(T10.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDateWhole,/*到期日*/ ROUND(t8.PRIN_AMT, 4) prinAmt,/*还本面额/百元*/ T8.RANGE_YIELD*100 yield,/*区间票面利率（%）*/ TO_CHAR(T8.PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') payDate,/*支付日*/ TO_CHAR(T8.PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate,/*交易日*/ ROUND(sum(T8.intAmt), 8) intAmtTheory,/*理论应计利息*/ ROUND(sum(T8.prinAmt), 4) prinAmtTheory,/*理论还本金额*/ T10.TRADE_MARKET, ROUND(sum(t8.fpriceAmt), 4) fpriceAmt,/*理论本息总额*/ NULL PA_BUSS_TYPE from (select T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.AMOUNT QTY, listagg(T1.CASH_TYPE, ',') within group ( order by T1.CASH_ID ) CASH_TYPE, listagg(T1.CASH_ID, ',') within group ( order by T1.CASH_ID ) CASH_ID, min(T1.VDATE) VDATE, T1.MDATE, SUM(T1.CASH_AMT * T1.AMOUNT) fpriceAmt, sum(case when T1.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE01}, '04') then 0 else T1.PRIN_AMT * T1.AMOUNT end) prinAmt, max(T1.INT_PRIN_AMT) INT_PRIN_AMT, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, SUM(T1.PRIN_AMT) PRIN_AMT, SUM(T1.INT_AMT) INT_AMT, SUM(T1.int_amt * T1.AMOUNT) intAmt, T1.PAY_DATE, max(t1.RANGE_YIELD) RANGE_YIELD from (SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, DECODE(T1.HODING_TYPE, '06', T1.AMOUNT*-1,'11', T1.AMOUNT*-1, T1.AMOUNT)/100 AMOUNT, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, t2.vdate, t2.mdate, t2.cash_amt, t2.prin_amt, TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPDA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where TDTA.MP_FINPROD_ID IS NULL and TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPDA.BUSI_TYPE = #{TRD10} AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} and T2.MDATE = TPDA.MDATE AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND (TPDA.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR TPDA.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPDA LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPDA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where TDTA.MP_FINPROD_ID IS NULL and TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPDA.BUSI_TYPE = #{TRD10} AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} and T2.MDATE >= TPDA.MDATE AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND (TPDA.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR TPDA.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE tpsp where tpsp.HODING_TYPE = T1.HODING_TYPE and tpsp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, T1.PAY_DATE) T8 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T8.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SAI ON T8.SEC_ACCT_ID = SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT
